  WEDNESDAY, JULY 10, 2019 AT 5:30 P.M.

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that I, LUCIE COLOMBO, CMC , City Clerk/ Secretary of
the City of Hawaiian Gardens hereby give notice and certify that Mayor Myra Maravilla
has called a Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens to be
held on Wednesday, July 10, 2019 commencing at 5:30 PM, at the City of Hawaiian
Gardens, Public Safety Center, 11940 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, CA
90716.

ADA Information: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance please
contact the City Clerk's Department at (562) 420-2641 , at least one business day prior
to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

Bilingual Information: Anyone needing a bilingual Spanish interpreter for ORAL
COMMUNICATION ONLY, please contact the City Clerk's Department at
(562) 420-2641, at least one (1) business day prior to the meeting so that we may
accommodate you.

  PLEASE TURN YOUR CELL PHONES OFF DURING THE MEETING.

AGENDA ITEM PUBLIC COMMENT
The City Council shall provide an opportunity for the public to address the Council on
each agenda item before Council's consideration of the item. A member of the public
wishing to speak on one agenda item that is eligible for public comment shall be given
an opportunity to speak for up to three (3) minute when that item is considered by City
Council.

  CITY COUNCIL
  STAFF REPORT

DATE:  July 10, 2019

TO:  Honorable Mayor and Members of the City Council

FROM:  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager

SUBJECT:  DISCUSSION OF REVENUE ENHANCEMENT OPPORTUNITIES

BACKGROUND

As a follow up to discussions and direction provided for during the budget process for the
Adopted 2019-2021 Citywide Budget, the City Council requested to discuss revenue
improvement prospects in an effort fo mitigate future revenue shortfalls.

FISCAL IMPACT

None. The Adopted 2019-2021 Citywide Budget includes funds for initiation and
implementation of revenue enhancement opportunities if directed to do so.

RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the City Council discuss new revenue generating opportunities and
direct staff as appropriate.

ATTACHMENTS

None.

  STAFF REPORT

DATE:  July 10, 2019

TO:  Honorable Mayor and Members of City Council

FROM:  Ernie Hernandez, City Manager

SUBJECT:  DISCUSSION OF COMMUNITY INPUT FOR AQUATIC CENTER
  AND WALKING TRAIL

BACKGROUND

As a follow up to discussions and input provided by the community during the
three community meetings held on June 1ath at the Public Safety Center, June 19th
at the Lee Ware Park Outdoor Shelter, and June 22 nd at the City Hall Council
Chambers for the proposed aquatic center and walking trail.

FISCAL IMPACT

None. The City has contracted with Global Urban Strategies to submit the City's
grant application for the SPP Grant to the California Department of Parks &
Recreation.

RECOMMENDATION

City council to discuss and make recommendations on project specifications.

ATTACHMENTS

None.
